applied.text: Project dashboard, cycle page and summary merged into one single-page view, following the wireframe on the board: project name and description at the top, the contributions chart full width, a left column with a Live site link and a 'Cycles' list (newest first, current selected), and the selected cycle in the main panel. Selecting a cycle switches instantly without a page load. The selected cycle's bar animates wider with an indicator underneath, and its details (date, contributions per type) show inline next to the chart. The cycle shows a 'Lucidchart docs' tab (selected by default) with simplified document cards in the animated card stack, followed by the changes made this cycle, and a second 'Summary' tab. Run harvest moved to the selected cycle's header (current cycle only). Old /cycle.html and /summary.html links still open the same view.
applied.author: John Dilworth
